nodes.question: How does the pore structure of REEs/C-8 contribute to its performance in Pb(II) removal?
nodes.answer: The superior removal capacity of REEs/C-8 is attributed to the enrichment of more REEs and a more abundant pore structure that enhances its effectiveness.
